sentences.en: Conclusion:Interstitial MR lymphography can clearly display anatomic form and function of lymph nodes and lymphatic vessel in the head and neck.

sentences.en: Conclusion The lymphography yielded high resolving images and positive rate, which has a guide significance to lateral clearance and paraabdominal aorta clearance of the lymph node.

sentences.en: Interstitial MR lymphography with submucous injection of omniscan is feasible and safe for diagnostics of lymph node metastasis in patients with oral cancer.

sentences.en: Conclusion:Interstital SPIO enhanced MR lymphography is a promising technique to demonstrate reactive hyperplastic lymph nodes.

sentences.en: Compared with direct lymphography, this technique caused little discomfort and took a short time.

sentences.en: Using indirect lymphography by subepidermal infusion of Isovist-300, the authors examined 20 patients with varicosity or edema of the limbs.
